plain_english: As an emperor among things is honored by all people as king, so among worlds the yoga-fallen is honored by all gods.
sanskrit_cite: viṣayeṣu sārvabhaumaḥ sarvajanaiḥ pūjyate yathā rājā | bhuvaneṣu sarvadaivair yogabhraṣṭas tathā pūjyaḥ

plain_english: After long time, humanity got, yoga practised — getting the divine deathless whence turning back no more.
sanskrit_cite: mahatā kālena punar mānuṣyaṃ prāpya yogam abhyasya | prāpnoti divyam amṛtam yasmād āvartate na punaḥ

plain_english: Therefore whoever, devoted on the true path here, goes — he to Śiva-ness: thinking so, in truth yet strive.
sanskrit_cite: tasmāt sanmārge 'smin nirato yaḥ kaścid eti sa śivatvam | iti matvā paramārthe yathā tathāpi prayatanīyam

plain_english: Meditating this supreme brahman, briefly told by Abhinavagupta — soon indeed Śiva-ness enters own-heart-dwelling.
sanskrit_cite: idam abhinavaguptoditasaṃkṣepaṃ dhyāyataḥ paraṃ brahma | acirād eva śivatvaṃ nijahṛdayāveśam abhyeti

plain_english: In a hundred āryās this condensed recondite teaching-essence — by Abhinavagupta, by me, kindled by Śiva-feet-memory.
sanskrit_cite: āryāśatena tad idaṃ saṃkṣiptaṃ śāstrasāram atigūḍham | abhinavaguptena mayā śivacaraṇasmaraṇadīptena
